.. change::
    :tags: bug, orm, declarative
    :tickets: 9147

    Fixed a memory leak in declarative mappings that use
    ``__declare_first__`` or ``__declare_last__``.  Declarative now installs
    one shared pair of mapper-configuration listeners and keeps only weak
    references to participating mapped classes, instead of installing a new
    global listener that strongly retained every such class.
